notes.title: PACT can now start minimized!
notes.content: As per user request, I've now added a feature to start PACT minimized, this update was long overdue but I hope you can enjoy PACT better with this new QoL Feature.

notes.title: PACT 15% off for a limited time.
notes.content:
Remember, PACT is and will remain open-source, so don't feel obligated to pay for it if you can't afford or don't want to support it financially.

By the people, for the people.
